content: {"like":["Enjoys strong, nuanced performances in period dramas like Colin Firth in Pride & Prejudice","Values detailed, character-driven storytelling in political dramas such as House of Cards","Appreciates authentic period settings and props in classic series like Mad Men","Seeks emotionally resonant music moments, exemplified by Beatles Anthology’s opening notes","Prefers high-quality audio-visual presentation in premium Blu‑ray releases"],"dislike":["Dislikes historical documentaries that omit key regional perspectives, as with Ken Burns’ baseball series","Finds modern political thrillers lacking depth compared to earlier seasons, e.g., House of Cards S3","Rejects poorly cast actors in iconic roles, such as Hayden Christensen in Star Wars I‑III","Criticizes documentaries that exclude significant figures, like missing Faye Resnick in 30‑for‑30","Dislikes content that fails to play on standard DVD players, e.g., LILLIE reissue"]}
